title: Gummy Bear Sunflower - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Unusual Variety
description:
Bring a ray of sunshine to your garden with these vibrant, fluffy yellow sunflowers!




 KEY FEATURES


• Vibrant, fluffy lemon-yellow double flowers (3-5 inches diameter)


• Awarded the prestigious Fleuroselect Gold Medal


• Multi-branched plants with abundant, long-lasting blooms


• Excellent for cutting and crafting with minimal pollen


• Adds eye-catching colour and height to gardens and containers




 PLANT DETAILS


Type: Houseplants — Helianthus annuus


Colour: Lemon Yellow


Season: Summer (Flowering from June to September)


Growth Habit: Upright, multi-branched


Time to Harvest: 75-85 days from seeding to bloom




 GROWING CONDITIONS


Sun: Full Sun (6-8 hours direct sunlight daily)


Soil: Well-draining, fertile loamy soil with neutral pH (6.0-7.0)


Watering: Consistent, moderate watering (approx. 1 inch per week), keeping soil evenly moist but not waterlogged. Water 1-2 times weekly at the base, increasing frequency in hot, dry conditions.


Spacing: Plants 12-18 inches apart, rows 30 inches apart


Height: 36-48 inches (90-120 cm)


Spread: 24-35 inches (50-90 cm)


Hardiness: USDA Zones 3-9




 CARE INSTRUCTIONS


• Plant in a location with full sun exposure for optimal growth and flowering.


• Ensure soil is well-draining and enriched with compost; maintain consistent moisture without overwatering.


• Support taller plants if necessary, especially in windy areas, to prevent stem breakage.


• Harvest flowers in the morning just after they open for best vase life; cutting the central flower head can promote side shoots.


• Protect young plants from common pests like cutworms and birds, especially during establishment.




 WHAT'S INCLUDED


2x Mini Plug Plants




 DISPATCH


Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
